note: Stage contract and Stage 2 target table. Data only; stage2.py reads it. Not a product decision. See README 'Assumptions (PROVISIONAL)'.

tools.side_effects: none; the entrypoint is never launched

tools.source: stage2.py (fixed argument vector built from targets below)
tools.side_effects: writes only a private temporary directory; runs only the binary just built from digest-verified fixture inputs

stages.name: static metadata
stages.input: one relative Manifest file below an explicitly selected directory

stages.name: host build/test of approved self-made fixtures
stages.input: a target id from this table; directory and exact source/header bytes must match the approval pinned in stage2.py
may_run: clang with the fixed argument vector
the test binary built from the listed sources
must_not_run: Makefile/build scripts in the fixture directory
files not listed in the target
requires: prior stage result, if one is supplied, is passed
stages.stop_scope: a failed or not_run prior stage, unknown target, disallowed input or cwd, fixture digest mismatch, or invalid timeout ends Stage 2 without executing anything; a failed compile skips the test step

stages.name: Nagi target acceptance
requires: a real Nagi target and separate conditions
